reuse.why: Extends the shared getDateWithSkippedWeekend and threads holidays to all its callers, but the new isNonWorkingDay predicate is not exported, so server/schedules/app.ts re-writes the weekend-or-holiday test inline.

duplication.why: The weekend-or-holiday check appears inline twice in schedules/app.ts besides isNonWorkingDay, and getUpcomingDates gains a copy of getDatesInRange's daily-skip flatMap.

placement.why: The moving rule rightly lives in shared/schedules.ts, but the daily-skip decision stays spread across getNextDate and two server functions instead of one shared definition.

scope.why: getUpcomingDates is restructured beyond the holiday rule (daily schedules no longer pass through getDateWithSkippedWeekend, an over-fetch of count + holidays + 14 and slicing).

maintainability.why: The same 'non-working day' rule now has three spellings and the daily-skip loop two copies, with a magic over-fetch, so the next change to what counts as a non-working day must be made in several places.

bypasses_abstraction.where: server/schedules/app.ts getUpcomingDates and getDatesInRange test d.isWeekend(date) || config.holidays?.includes(dayFromDate(date)) instead of a shared isNonWorkingDay.

disguised_duplication.where: The daily-skip flatMap copied into getUpcomingDates is reshaped from getDatesInRange's, and the inline holiday checks restate the private isNonWorkingDay with optional chaining.

one_place.where: Date moving is in getDateWithSkippedWeekend (shared), but the daily-skip 'non-working day' rule is decided in isNonWorkingDay (getNextDate) and separately inline in getUpcomingDates and getDatesInRange.
